title: Worth magazine (Jason Allen Ashlock) — 'a minimum viable product for a better capitalism'
summary: Worth magazine publishes a substantive review by Jason Allen Ashlock, characterizing Incorruptible as Ries's most consequential contribution to business thinking. Reads the three-part structure through failed companies (Whole Foods, Boeing, Polaroid), the mission-drive counterforce, and governance solutions including super-voting shares and steward ownership. Foregrounds Costco compounding at roughly 58x the S&P 500 since its 1985 IPO.
blockquote: Financial gravity is enforced not only by bad actors but by good ones acting rationally under bad structures.
